card.name: Per-day wording in dose amounts
card.fires_on: The word day or daily in dose-rate phrases, such as "mg/kg/day", "total daily dose" and "per day", mostly in dosing directions.

modes.label: mg/kg/day
modes.description: The "/day" ending after a weight-based amount, often for corticosteroid doses.
modes.example: administer systemic corticosteroid therapy (1 to 2 mg/kg<</day>> prednisone or equivalent) until improvement

modes.label: Total daily dose
modes.description: The word daily or day in phrases that give a total amount over a day.

modes.description: A rare case inside the word intravenously in a loading-dose instruction.
modes.example: Loading dose : 300 mg Noxafil injection intr<<aven>>ously twice a day on the first day
